test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Since the little girl answers / a few simple questions, / her parents say that / she is too intelligent.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of "**too intelligent**" in** part D.**
 
• Using "**too intelligent**" implies more intelligence than is acceptable or needed, which is not the intended meaning. The correct wording should be "**very intelligent**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part D **of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3)**

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Since the little girl answers a few simple questions, her parents say **that she is very intelligent**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Since the little girl answers** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **her parents say that** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **she is too intelligent** – The word "too" is incorrect here, and "very" should be used instead.
 
• **a few simple questions** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
